title: J0nasW/science-datalake
description:
Science Data Lake (release 2026.10)
	

A DOI-linked, source-preserving integration of open scholarly metadata. Six open sources
are linked through normalised DOIs while every source keeps its own schema and values,
so that measurements from different sources (three citation counts, two retraction
signals) can be compared directly.

Release: 2026.10 (tag v2026.10), DOI 10.57967/hf/XXXX
Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the whole dataset (see LICENSE; component sources and their licences… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/J0nasW/science-datalake.
